description: This file contains parameter definitions and functions related to IPv6 options, including retrieval functions for server prefixes and DUT mappings based on EA-length parameters.

methods.name: Get_SrvPrefix48_ipv6opt
methods.description: Retrieves the server prefix IPv6 address based on the EA-length parameter.

methods.name: Get_DutMapEv4_ipv6opt
methods.description: Retrieves the DUT mapping IPv4 address based on the EA-length parameter.

methods.name: Get_DutMapEv6_SN_ipv6opt
methods.description: Retrieves the DUT mapping IPv6 address based on the EA-length parameter.
